description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for employment status search filtering parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and allows setting and retrieving a 'name' filter, as well as specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering employment status search results, allows setting a 'name' filter and managing sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with a default sort field 'es.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.
